evidence_boundaries: Dedicated skill documentation identifies Chaos Shot as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super used by Frost and acquired from the TP Medal Shop.
Official Bandai Namco documentation confirms TP Medals remain earnable and usable in-game after the May 2024 sales transition.
The historical mapping of Chaos Shot to the Free Update 1 TP Medal Shop addition remains source-supported rather than directly enumerated by the official announcement.
No skill identity, classification, acquisition endpoint, or shop semantics were changed beyond provenance refresh.
